preconditions.expression: all(1 <= t <= 10**4 for t in [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines() if line.strip().isdigit()])
preconditions.description: The first line of input is the number of test cases t, where 1 ≤ t ≤ 10^4.

preconditions.expression: all(len(lines) == 4 for lines in [stdin.splitlines()[i:i+4] for i in range(1, len(stdin.splitlines()), 4)])
preconditions.description: Each test case consists of exactly 4 lines: n and m, array a, k, and array b.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 5*10**4 and 2 <= m <= 10**9 for n, m in [tuple(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::4]])
preconditions.description: For each test case, n is the length of array a (1 ≤ n ≤ 5*10^4) and m is the magic number (2 ≤ m ≤ 10^9).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= k <= 5*10**4 for k in [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[3::4]])
preconditions.description: For each test case, k is the length of array b (1 ≤ k ≤ 5*10^4).

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 10**9 for a in [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::4]] for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: All elements in array a satisfy 1 ≤ a_i ≤ 10^9.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= b_i <= 10**9 for b in [list(map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[4::4]] for b_i in b)
preconditions.description: All elements in array b satisfy 1 ≤ b_i ≤ 10^9.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout.strip() in ['Yes', 'No', 'yes', 'no', 'YES', 'NO'] for stdout in [line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[5::5]])
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is either 'Yes' or 'No' (case-insensitive) indicating whether array a can be transformed into array b using the allowed operations.

postconditions.expression: all(len(stdout.strip()) == 2 for stdout in [line.strip() for line in stdin.splitlines()[5::5]])
postconditions.description: The output for each test case is exactly two characters (case-insensitive).

postconditions.expression: all((sorted(a) == sorted(b) and sum(a) == sum(b)) or (lambda a, b, m: (lambda f: f(f))(lambda rec: (lambda arr: any((all(arr[i] == arr[i+1] for i in range(len(arr)-1)) and len(arr) >= m and rec([arr[0]*m] + arr[m:]) == rec(b) or any(arr[i] % m == 0 and rec(arr[:i] + [arr[i]//m]*m + arr[i+1:]) == rec(b) for i in range(len(arr))) or arr == b)))(a))(a, b, m) for a, b, m in [(list(map(int, stdin.splitlines()[2 + 4*i].split())), list(map(int, stdin.splitlines()[4 + 4*i].split())), int(stdin.splitlines()[1 + 4*i].split()[1])) for i in range(int(stdin.splitlines()[0]))])
postconditions.description: The output 'Yes' is correct if and only if array a can be transformed into array b using any number of the two operations. The operations are: (1) replacing an element divisible by m with m copies of its quotient, or (2) replacing m consecutive equal elements with their product. The transformation is valid if the multiset of elements in a can be reduced to the multiset of elements in b through these operations.
